sources.title: Run Gemma 4 Locally: From 4 GB VRAM (E4B) to 31B, Free
sources.snippet: Google released Gemma 4 in April 2026 and it immediately became one of the most important open-weight model families for local AI. From the tiny E2B that runs on anything to the frontier 31B dense model, Gemma 4 covers every use case. Native tool calling, vision support, 256K context, and an Apache 2.0 license make it the go-to recommendation for new users. This guide covers every Gemma 4 ...
